scope: Reviewed the Japanese article and twelve translations for current settings navigation, the official unlocked indicator, carrier-unlock responsibility, used-device context, dates, and links.
findings: Removed duplicate future dates and retained the original publication date; set lastmod to the review date.
Aligned menu path to Settings > General > About and described “No SIM restrictions” / the localized equivalent as the positive unlocked indicator.
Clarified that only the current carrier can unlock an iPhone and that unlock status does not guarantee network, service, or eSIM compatibility.
Distinguished carrier lock from a SIM PIN lock and added current Apple Support references.
